entities.summary: The Japan Times is Japan's largest and oldest English-language daily newspaper. It is published by The Japan Times, Ltd. , a subsidiary of News2u Holdings, Inc. It is headquartered in the Kioicho Building  in Kioicho, Chiyoda, Tokyo .
